title: 橋梁轉體施工~Bridge rotation construction
focus: 以球鉸承壓、重心平衡、摩擦力矩與牽引控制，把在障礙物旁建好的萬噸級橋體安全轉到設計軸線~Spherical-hinge bearing, centre-of-gravity balance, friction torque and traction control that swing a structure of thousands of tonnes from beside an obstacle onto its design axis
summary: 從平行於鐵路、道路或河道建造、再轉到跨越位置的工法邏輯出發，計算轉體重量、重心偏心與撐腳間隙，再處理球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩、下轉盤局部承壓、牽引系統、到位精調與封鉸，最後以稱重試驗、轉動監測與封固後的沉陷與淨空檢核驗收，並以比利時 Ben-Ahin 斜張橋、塞維亞 Barqueta 拱橋的浮力旋轉與石板坡鋼箱梁的轉向對照。~Starting from the logic of building parallel to a railway, road or river and then swinging into the crossing position, compute rotating weight, centre-of-gravity eccentricity and support-leg gaps, then handle spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque, local bearing in the lower turntable, the traction system, final positioning and hinge encasement, and finally accept with a weighing test, rotation monitoring and post-encasement settlement and clearance checks, contrasting Belgium's Ben-Ahin cable-stayed bridge, the floating swing of Seville's Barqueta arch and the turning of the Shibanpo steel box.

units.anchor: 轉動 T 構與跨越線~Rotating T-frame and the crossing line
units.title: 轉體工法的系統與適用情境~System logic and where rotation fits
units.mechanism: 轉體施工把橋梁上部結構先在不影響交通或河道的位置（通常平行於鐵路或河岸）以支架、懸臂或預製方式建好，再以橋墩頂或承台中的轉動中心旋轉到設計軸線。水平轉體最常見：一座平衡懸臂 T 構或斜張橋半跨坐在球鉸上，繞豎軸旋轉數十度；豎向轉體則把拱肋半跨先豎直或平躺建造，再繞拱腳的水平軸轉下或轉起；另有以浮箱支撐一端、繞另一端旋轉的浮運轉體。其核心價值是把跨越營運中鐵路或航道的高風險時段，壓縮成一次可控的數小時作業。~Rotation construction builds the superstructure where it does not obstruct traffic or navigation, usually parallel to a railway or riverbank, by falsework, cantilevering or prefabrication, then swings it onto the design axis about a pivot in the pier top or pile cap. Horizontal rotation is most common: a balanced-cantilever T-frame or half of a cable-stayed bridge sits on a spherical hinge and turns tens of degrees about a vertical axis. Vertical rotation builds arch-rib halves upright or lying down and turns them about a horizontal axis at the springing; floating rotation supports one end on pontoons and pivots about the other. Its core value is compressing the high-risk period over a live railway or waterway into one controlled operation of a few hours.
units.model: 懸臂端半徑 r = 60 m、轉角 70° = 1.222 rad：端點弧長 s = r·θ = 60×1.222 ≈ 73.3 m。若端點速度上限 1.5 m/min，純轉動時間約 73.3/1.5 ≈ 49 min，角速度 1.5/60 = 0.025 rad/min。數值為教學假設。~With a cantilever tip radius r = 60 m and a rotation of 70° = 1.222 rad, the tip travels s = r·θ = 60×1.222 ≈ 73.3 m. At a tip speed limit of 1.5 m/min, pure rotation takes about 73.3/1.5 ≈ 49 min, an angular speed of 1.5/60 = 0.025 rad/min. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 方案比選時以平面圖檢查轉動掃過的範圍：懸臂端與斜張索在整個轉動弧內不得碰觸電車線、號誌、既有建物或航道設施，並保留安全間距；同時以時程表確認轉動作業（含準備、試轉、轉動與精調）能放進業主核准的鐵路封鎖或交通管制時段。~During option selection, check the swept area on plan: the cantilever tips and stays must clear catenary, signals, existing buildings and waterway facilities throughout the rotation arc with a safety margin, and a time schedule must show that preparation, trial turning, rotation and fine adjustment fit inside the railway possession or traffic closure approved by the owner.
units.failure: 若規劃時只看起點與終點位置，忽略轉動弧線中段的淨空，懸臂端可能在轉動途中逼近電車線或鄰近結構，只能中途停止，讓結構停在既非施工位置也非設計位置的不利狀態。~Planning only the start and end positions and ignoring clearance along the middle of the arc can bring a tip close to catenary or a neighbouring structure mid-turn, forcing a stop that leaves the structure in neither its construction nor its design position.
units.misconception: 轉體只是把橋轉個方向，結構受力與一般懸臂施工完全相同。~Rotation just turns the bridge, so its forces are identical to ordinary cantilever construction.
units.practice: 可行性研究階段就與鐵路或航道主管機關確認封鎖時段長度、轉動弧內的淨空要求與緊急恢復程序，並把這些條件寫入設計基準，而不是留給承包商在施工前才協調。~At feasibility stage, agree possession length, clearances along the swept arc and emergency recovery procedures with the railway or waterway authority and write them into the design basis rather than leaving them to the contractor just before construction.

units.title: 轉體重量、重心與撐腳平衡~Rotating weight, centre of gravity and leg balance
units.mechanism: 水平轉體時，整個上部結構與上轉盤只靠中心球鉸承重，周圍一圈撐腳與環形滑道保持數公釐到數十公釐的間隙，只在結構傾斜時接觸，作為防傾的保險。理論上兩側懸臂重量相等，但混凝土實際密度、斷面尺寸、預力與施工殘留物都會造成重心偏離球鉸中心，形成不平衡力矩。若不平衡力矩過大，撐腳會壓在滑道上摩擦，使牽引力暴增；因此設計常要求先量出偏心，再以配重調整，或刻意保留很小的縱向偏心，使結構穩定地以球鉸加一側撐腳轉動。~In horizontal rotation the whole superstructure and upper turntable rest only on the central spherical hinge, while a ring of support legs keeps a gap of a few to tens of millimetres above an annular slideway and touches it only if the structure tilts, as an anti-overturning safeguard. In theory the two cantilevers weigh the same, but actual concrete density, section sizes, prestress and construction leftovers shift the centre of gravity off the hinge, creating an unbalanced moment. If it is large, legs bear on the slideway and friction greatly increases the traction needed, so designs usually require the eccentricity to be measured and corrected with ballast, or a very small longitudinal eccentricity kept on purpose so the structure turns steadily on the hinge plus one leg pair.
units.model: 轉體重 W = 150,000 kN、重心偏心 e = 0.05 m：不平衡力矩 M = W·e = 7,500 kN·m；若由半徑 4.0 m 的撐腳承擔，撐腳力 7,500/4.0 = 1,875 kN。撐腳間隙 10 mm、撐腳半徑 4.5 m 時，傾角上限 0.010/4.5 ≈ 0.0022 rad，對應 60 m 懸臂端豎向位移約 133 mm。數值為教學假設。~For a rotating weight W = 150,000 kN and centre-of-gravity eccentricity e = 0.05 m, the unbalanced moment M = W·e = 7,500 kN·m; carried by legs at 4.0 m radius, the leg force is 7,500/4.0 = 1,875 kN. With a 10 mm leg gap at 4.5 m radius, tilt is limited to 0.010/4.5 ≈ 0.0022 rad, about 133 mm vertical movement at a 60 m tip. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工紀錄（實測混凝土單位重、斷面尺寸、預力與附屬物）重新計算重心，並與稱重試驗結果比較；撐腳與滑道的間隙在轉動前逐點量測並記錄，任何一點間隙為零或過大都要查明原因。~Recalculate the centre of gravity from construction records (measured concrete unit weight, section dimensions, prestress and attachments) and compare with the weighing test; measure and record the gap at every leg before rotation, investigating any leg with zero or excessive gap.
units.failure: 未量測偏心就轉動，撐腳在滑道上一路摩擦，牽引力超過千斤頂容量而卡在半途；偏心更大時結構傾斜到撐腳承壓，滑道局部壓碎，懸臂端下沉侵入下方鐵路淨空。~Rotating without measuring eccentricity lets legs scrape along the slideway so traction exceeds jack capacity and the turn stalls halfway; larger eccentricity tilts the structure onto its legs, crushing the slideway locally and dropping a tip into the railway clearance below.
units.misconception: 對稱設計的 T 構兩側重量必定相等，不需要配重。~A symmetrically designed T-frame is always balanced and never needs ballast.
units.practice: 施工中持續累計兩側懸臂的實際重量（含預力、護欄預埋件與殘留模板），並在設計文件中訂明容許偏心與配重調整程序；配重的重量與位置由設計單位核定。~Keep a running tally of the actual weight of each cantilever during construction, including prestress, barrier embedments and leftover formwork, and state the allowable eccentricity and ballast procedure in the design documents; ballast weight and position are approved by the designer.

units.anchor: 球鉸與聚四氟乙烯滑片~Spherical hinge and PTFE pads
units.title: 球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩~Spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque
units.mechanism: 球鉸由上下兩片球面鋼板組成：下球面板固定在下轉盤，上球面板固定在上轉盤，兩者之間嵌入聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑片並塗抹潤滑脂。球面讓結構在豎直力作用下自動對中，也允許少量傾斜；滑片把接觸應力限制在材料容許範圍，並提供低而穩定的摩擦。轉動時的阻力主要是球鉸摩擦力矩，它與總重、摩擦係數與球鉸半徑成正比，所以球鉸做得越大，接觸應力越低，但摩擦力矩反而越大，這是球鉸尺寸設計的核心取捨。~A spherical hinge consists of two spherical steel plates: the lower one fixed in the lower turntable and the upper one in the upper turntable, with greased PTFE pads inset between them. The spherical shape self-centres the structure under vertical load and permits a little tilt, while the pads keep contact stress within material limits and give low, stable friction. Rotation resistance is mainly the hinge friction torque, proportional to total weight, friction coefficient and hinge radius; a larger hinge lowers contact stress but raises friction torque, the central trade-off in sizing the hinge.
units.model: 球鉸投影半徑 R = 2.0 m：面積 π×2.0² ≈ 12.57 m²，W = 150,000 kN 時平均接觸應力 σ ≈ 150,000/12.57 ≈ 11.9 MPa。以均布壓力近似，摩擦力矩 M_f = (2/3)·μ·W·R；設計摩擦 μ = 0.06 時 M_f = (2/3)×0.06×150,000×2.0 = 12,000 kN·m。數值為教學假設。~With a projected hinge radius R = 2.0 m, the area is π×2.0² ≈ 12.57 m² and the average contact stress for W = 150,000 kN is σ ≈ 150,000/12.57 ≈ 11.9 MPa. Approximating uniform pressure, the friction torque is M_f = (2/3)·μ·W·R; with a design friction μ = 0.06, M_f = (2/3)×0.06×150,000×2.0 = 12,000 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 球鉸在工廠完成後量測球面曲率半徑、表面粗糙度與滑片嵌入深度，並做組合試驗；現場安裝時以精密水準確認下球面板水平度與中心位置，澆置下轉盤混凝土時防止球面板浮動或變形，完成後再複測。~After shop fabrication, measure the sphere radius, surface roughness and pad recess depth and carry out an assembly check; on site, verify the levelness and centre of the lower plate by precise levelling, prevent it floating or distorting while the lower turntable is cast, and re-survey afterwards.
units.failure: 下球面板在澆置時偏移或傾斜，上下球面無法密貼，接觸集中在局部，滑片被擠出或磨損，摩擦力矩遠大於設計值；潤滑脂混入砂土同樣會使摩擦暴增，轉動時出現停頓跳動。~If the lower plate shifts or tilts during casting, the spheres do not seat, contact concentrates locally, pads extrude or wear and friction torque far exceeds design; grease contaminated with sand also sharply raises friction, causing stick-slip jumps during rotation.
units.misconception: 球鉸做得越大越安全，轉動也會越省力。~A bigger spherical hinge is always safer and also easier to turn.
units.practice: 球鉸的製造、運輸、安裝與保護（防塵、防雨、防焊渣）應有專屬程序，安裝完成至轉動前以保護罩覆蓋；滑片材料與潤滑脂須有出廠檢驗與摩擦試驗報告。~Hinge fabrication, transport, installation and protection from dust, rain and weld spatter need a dedicated procedure, with a protective cover from installation until rotation; pad material and grease require mill certificates and friction test reports.

units.anchor: 下轉盤局部承壓~Local bearing in the lower turntable
units.title: 上下轉盤、撐腳與滑道細部~Turntables, support legs and slideway details
units.mechanism: 球鉸把數萬噸的力量集中在直徑數公尺的範圍內，下轉盤（承台頂部）必須把這股集中力擴散到下方的樁基，同時抵抗局部壓碎與劈裂；上轉盤則把橋墩傳下的力量收攏到球鉸上，承受很大的徑向拉力。兩者都需密集配置環向與徑向鋼筋及多層鋼筋網。撐腳常為鋼管混凝土，底部有滑靴，環形滑道則是嵌入下轉盤的不鏽鋼板，平整度直接影響撐腳一旦接觸時的摩擦與衝擊。~The hinge concentrates tens of thousands of tonnes onto an area a few metres across, so the lower turntable on top of the pile cap must spread this force into the piles while resisting local crushing and splitting; the upper turntable gathers pier forces onto the hinge and carries large radial tension. Both need dense hoop and radial reinforcement and several layers of mesh. Support legs are often concrete-filled steel tubes with sliding shoes, and the annular slideway is a stainless steel plate set into the lower turntable whose flatness governs friction and impact if a leg touches.
units.model: 局部承壓強度 F_Rdu = A_c0·f_cd·√(A_c1/A_c0)。C40 混凝土 f_cd = 40/1.5 ≈ 26.7 MPa；球鉸承壓直徑 4 m、擴散直徑 6 m，面積比 (6/4)² = 2.25，√2.25 = 1.5，局部承壓強度 26.7×1.5 ≈ 40 MPa，大於平均接觸應力 11.9 MPa 但仍需配置抗劈裂鋼筋。數值為教學假設。~Local bearing resistance F_Rdu = A_c0·f_cd·√(A_c1/A_c0). For C40 concrete f_cd = 40/1.5 ≈ 26.7 MPa; with a 4 m loaded diameter spreading to 6 m, the area ratio is (6/4)² = 2.25 and √2.25 = 1.5, giving a local bearing strength of 26.7×1.5 ≈ 40 MPa, above the 11.9 MPa average contact stress but still requiring splitting reinforcement. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 下轉盤混凝土澆置前逐項檢查鋼筋網層數、間距與球鉸錨筋，澆置時以分層振動並監測球面板高程；環形滑道安裝後以水準儀量測全周平整度（例如任意 1 m 內高差小於 2 mm），撐腳與滑道間隙逐一記錄。~Before casting the lower turntable, check mesh layers, spacing and hinge anchor bars item by item, vibrate in layers while monitoring the plate level; after installing the slideway, level its full circumference, for example within 2 mm over any 1 m, and record the gap at every leg.
units.failure: 下轉盤鋼筋過密而混凝土未振實，球鉸下方出現蜂窩，轉動時局部壓碎使球鉸下沉傾斜；滑道接縫錯台使撐腳一旦接觸就卡住，轉動中出現衝擊與停頓。~Congested reinforcement with poorly compacted concrete leaves honeycombing under the hinge that crushes during rotation so the hinge sinks and tilts; a step at a slideway joint snags any leg that touches, causing impacts and stalls during rotation.
units.misconception: 承台本來就很大，承受球鉸集中力不需要特別配筋。~A pile cap is so massive that it needs no special reinforcement for the hinge load.
units.practice: 下轉盤與球鉸區應以實體模型或三維鋼筋圖預先檢查可施工性，必要時改用自充填混凝土；撐腳、滑道與球鉸的安裝精度列為停留點，由監造與設計單位共同驗收。~Check constructability of the lower turntable and hinge zone with a mock-up or 3D reinforcement model, using self-compacting concrete if needed; installation accuracy of legs, slideway and hinge is a hold point accepted jointly by the supervising engineer and designer.

units.anchor: 牽引索與連續千斤頂~Traction strands and continuous jacks
units.title: 牽引系統與轉動力的配置~Traction system and turning force
units.mechanism: 水平轉體通常在上轉盤外圍纏繞鋼絞線牽引索，兩端分別接到對稱布置的兩台連續千斤頂，形成一對力偶推動結構旋轉，力偶不會對球鉸產生側向力。連續千斤頂以前後兩組夾持器交替工作，使牽引索連續前進而不需反覆換索。啟動瞬間要克服較大的靜摩擦，常另設助推千斤頂頂在撐腳或上轉盤上幫助啟動；轉動中則以較低的動摩擦力矩運行，並由電腦同步兩台千斤頂的行程與力量。~Horizontal rotation usually wraps strand traction cables around the upper turntable, each end connected to one of two symmetrically placed continuous jacks, forming a force couple that turns the structure without pushing the hinge sideways. Continuous jacks alternate front and rear grippers so the strands advance continuously without re-anchoring. At start-up the larger static friction must be overcome, often with auxiliary push jacks bearing on a leg or the upper turntable; during the turn the lower running friction torque applies, and a computer synchronises the strokes and forces of both jacks.
units.model: 牽引半徑 4.5 m、兩台千斤頂形成力偶：每台力 F = M_f/(2×4.5)。動摩擦 μ = 0.06 時 M_f = 12,000 kN·m，F ≈ 1,333 kN；啟動靜摩擦取 μ = 0.10，M_f = 20,000 kN·m，F ≈ 2,222 kN。千斤頂額定容量宜至少為啟動力的 1.5 至 2 倍。數值為教學假設。~With a 4.5 m traction radius and two jacks forming a couple, each jack force is F = M_f/(2×4.5). For running friction μ = 0.06, M_f = 12,000 kN·m and F ≈ 1,333 kN; for static breakaway μ = 0.10, M_f = 20,000 kN·m and F ≈ 2,222 kN. Rated jack capacity should be at least 1.5 to 2 times the breakaway force. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 牽引系統安裝後先做空載試運轉，確認兩台千斤頂同步、夾持器動作與油壓管路；正式轉動前做小角度試轉（例如轉動數度後停止），記錄啟動力與運行力，反算摩擦係數並與稱重試驗結果比較，再決定是否進入正式轉動。~After installation, run the traction system unloaded to confirm synchronisation, gripper action and hydraulic lines; before the main rotation, make a small trial turn of a few degrees, record breakaway and running forces, back-calculate friction and compare with the weighing test before deciding to proceed.
units.failure: 兩台千斤頂不同步時，力偶變成合力，對球鉸施加水平推力，結構偏離中心或撐腳單側受壓；牽引索在轉盤槽內交疊或跳槽，會使牽引力突然下降，結構在慣性與風力下產生非預期擺動。~Unsynchronised jacks turn the couple into a net force that pushes the hinge sideways, shifting the structure off-centre or loading legs on one side; strands overlapping or jumping out of the turntable groove cause a sudden loss of traction and unplanned swinging under wind.
units.misconception: 牽引力只要大於轉動阻力即可，千斤頂越大越好控制。~Traction only needs to exceed resistance, and bigger jacks are always easier to control.
units.practice: 牽引系統設計、試運轉與試轉都列為停留點，由專業技師與設計單位簽認；轉動指揮由單一總指揮下令，每一個監測點都能直接下達停止指令。~Traction design, unloaded trial and trial turn are hold points signed by a qualified engineer and the designer; the rotation is commanded by a single director, and every monitoring post can order an immediate stop.

units.anchor: 到位限位與封鉸混凝土~Stop blocks and hinge encasement
units.title: 轉動到位、精調與封鉸~Arrival, fine adjustment and hinge encasement
units.mechanism: 萬噸級結構以每分鐘幾公分的角速度轉動，動能其實很小，真正難的是精度：接近設計軸線時改為點動，每次只移動很小的距離，並在轉盤設置限位塊防止超轉。到位後以千斤頂微調軸線、高程與橫坡，接著以鋼楔或鋼支撐把上轉盤與下轉盤臨時鎖死，再在球鉸與撐腳周圍澆置封鉸混凝土，使轉動機構變成固結的墩底，最後與相鄰跨進行合龍。~A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes turning at a few centimetres per minute has very little kinetic energy; the difficulty is precision. Near the design axis the jacks switch to inching, moving a tiny distance each time, and stop blocks on the turntable prevent over-rotation. On arrival, jacks fine-tune axis, level and cross-fall, steel wedges or struts temporarily lock the upper turntable to the lower, and encasement concrete is cast around the hinge and legs so the mechanism becomes a fixed pier base before closure with the adjacent spans.
units.model: 以兩側 60 m 懸臂近似，迴轉半徑 r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m，質量 m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg，I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m²；ω = 0.025 rad/min ≈ 4.17×10⁻⁴ rad/s，動能 ½Iω² ≈ 1.6 kJ，極小。端點定位 ±10 mm 等於轉角 0.010/60 ≈ 1.67×10⁻⁴ rad，對應 4.5 m 牽引半徑上僅約 0.75 mm。數值為教學假設。~Treating two 60 m arms, the radius of gyration r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m, mass m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg and I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m²; at ω = 0.025 rad/min ≈ 4.17×10⁻⁴ rad/s the kinetic energy ½Iω² is only about 1.6 kJ. Positioning a tip to ±10 mm means 0.010/60 ≈ 1.67×10⁻⁴ rad, only about 0.75 mm at the 4.5 m traction radius. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 接近終點時以全站儀連續量測兩懸臂端座標，換算剩餘轉角並逐次點動；到位後確認軸線、高程與相鄰跨端點的對位在允差內（例如軸線 ±10 mm），鎖定後再複測一次，封鉸混凝土澆置前檢查鋼筋與清潔，並追蹤試體強度。~Near the end, track both tip coordinates continuously with total stations, convert to the remaining angle and inch accordingly; on arrival confirm axis, level and alignment with adjacent span ends within tolerance, for example ±10 mm on axis, re-survey after locking, check reinforcement and cleanliness before casting the encasement and track cylinder strength.
units.failure: 千斤頂控制解析度不足或靜摩擦黏滑，結構在終點前一下停滯、一下跳動，容易超轉；未先鎖定就開始封鉸，溫度變化或風力使結構在混凝土初凝期間微轉，封鉸混凝土開裂。~Coarse jack control or stick-slip friction makes the structure stall and jump near the end, easily overshooting; starting encasement before locking lets temperature or wind turn the structure slightly while the concrete sets, cracking the encasement.
units.misconception: 萬噸級結構轉動時慣性很大，到位時一定需要很大的制動力。~A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes has huge rotational inertia and needs a huge braking force at arrival.
units.practice: 轉動程序書須明訂點動開始的剩餘角度、限位塊位置、鎖定方式與封鉸澆置條件；鎖定與封鉸完成前，任何人不得移除牽引或限位裝置，並由設計單位確認封固後的體系轉換。~The rotation procedure must specify the remaining angle at which inching begins, stop-block positions, the locking method and encasement conditions; no one may remove traction or stop devices before locking and encasement are complete, and the designer confirms the system change after fixing.

units.anchor: 稱重試驗與不平衡力矩~Weighing test and unbalanced moment
units.title: 轉動前稱重試驗~Pre-rotation weighing test
units.mechanism: 拆除臨時支撐、讓結構完全落在球鉸上之後，要做稱重試驗：在撐腳附近兩側以千斤頂分別向上頂，量測千斤頂力與位移，找出位移突然增加的轉折點，代表結構開始繞球鉸轉動。由兩側的轉折點力量，可以同時解出重心偏心造成的不平衡力矩與球鉸的摩擦力矩，進而決定配重量與牽引力。這是轉體前唯一能直接量到真實狀態的機會，數據品質決定了後續所有判斷。~After temporary supports are removed and the structure rests fully on the hinge, a weighing test is carried out: jacks near the legs on each side push upward in turn while force and displacement are measured, and the point where displacement suddenly increases marks the start of rotation about the hinge. The turning-point forces from both sides solve simultaneously for the unbalanced moment due to eccentricity and the hinge friction moment, which then set the ballast and traction force. It is the only chance before rotation to measure the real state directly, and its data quality governs every later decision.
units.model: 兩側千斤頂距中心 a = 4.0 m，轉折力 P₁ = 2,600 kN、P₂ = 1,100 kN：不平衡力矩 M_G = (P₁ − P₂)·a/2 = 3,000 kN·m，摩擦力矩 M_F = (P₁ + P₂)·a/2 = 7,400 kN·m。偏心 e = 3,000/150,000 = 0.02 m，摩擦係數 μ = 3M_F/(2WR) = 3×7,400/(2×150,000×2.0) ≈ 0.037。數值為教學假設。~With jacks at a = 4.0 m from the centre and turning-point forces P₁ = 2,600 kN and P₂ = 1,100 kN, the unbalanced moment is M_G = (P₁ − P₂)·a/2 = 3,000 kN·m and the friction moment M_F = (P₁ + P₂)·a/2 = 7,400 kN·m. The eccentricity is e = 3,000/150,000 = 0.02 m and the friction coefficient μ = 3M_F/(2WR) = 3×7,400/(2×150,000×2.0) ≈ 0.037. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 千斤頂與位移計須事先校正，加載以小級距進行並繪製力—位移曲線，以兩種方法（曲線轉折點與切線交點）判讀並取一致結果；試驗至少重複一次，偏心與摩擦結果與施工重量計算比較，差異過大須查明原因並由設計單位決定配重。~Calibrate jacks and displacement gauges beforehand, load in small steps and plot force–displacement curves, read the turning point by two methods (curve break and tangent intersection) and require agreement; repeat at least once, compare eccentricity and friction with the construction weight calculation, and have the designer decide on ballast if they differ significantly.
units.failure: 若稱重時臨時支撐或砂箱未完全拆除，部分重量仍由支撐承擔，量到的摩擦力矩偏低、偏心判斷錯誤，正式轉動時牽引力不足或結構突然傾向一側。~If temporary supports or sand boxes are not fully removed, part of the weight bypasses the hinge, so measured friction is too low and eccentricity is misjudged; during the actual rotation traction proves insufficient or the structure suddenly leans to one side.
units.misconception: 球鉸摩擦係數可以直接採用材料型錄值，不必現場試驗。~The hinge friction coefficient can be taken from the catalogue without site testing.
units.practice: 稱重試驗前由監造確認所有臨時支撐、砂箱與鎖定裝置已解除並拍照記錄；試驗報告須含原始資料、判讀方法、計算結果與配重建議，經設計單位簽認後才能進入試轉。~Before the weighing test the supervising engineer confirms and photographs the release of all temporary supports, sand boxes and locks; the report must contain raw data, interpretation method, results and ballast recommendation, signed by the designer before any trial turn.

units.anchor: 轉動中監測與風速限制~Monitoring and wind limits during rotation
units.title: 轉動過程監測與停機條件~Monitoring and stop criteria during rotation
units.mechanism: 轉動期間結構處於一個與完工或施工階段都不同的臨時狀態：只有中心一點支承、兩側長懸臂、撐腳懸空。監測重點包括轉角與端點座標、兩懸臂端高程差、撐腳與滑道間隙、牽引力、墩身或轉盤應變，以及現場風速。風對長懸臂的影響主要不是水平扭轉，而是兩側不對稱的上揚或下壓力造成傾斜，可能使撐腳接觸滑道。每一項都必須事先設定警戒值與停止值。~During rotation the structure is in a temporary state unlike both construction and service: supported at a single central point with two long cantilevers and legs in the air. Monitoring covers rotation angle and tip coordinates, level difference between the tips, leg-to-slideway gaps, traction forces, pier or turntable strains and site wind speed. Wind acts on long cantilevers less through horizontal twisting than through unequal uplift or downward pressure on the two sides, which tilts the structure and can bring legs onto the slideway. Every quantity needs alert and stop values set in advance.
units.model: 風速 15 m/s 時動壓 q = 0.5×1.25×15² ≈ 141 Pa；一側懸臂寬 16 m、長 60 m，上揚係數 0.5 時 F = 0.5×141×960 ≈ 67.5 kN，作用於 30 m 處的傾覆力矩約 2,025 kN·m；與稱重殘餘不平衡 3,000 kN·m 疊加為 5,025 kN·m，若撐腳半徑 4.0 m 接觸，撐腳力約 1,256 kN。數值為教學假設。~At 15 m/s the dynamic pressure is q = 0.5×1.25×15² ≈ 141 Pa; for one arm 16 m wide and 60 m long with an uplift coefficient of 0.5, F = 0.5×141×960 ≈ 67.5 kN acting at 30 m gives about 2,025 kN·m of tilting moment; added to the 3,000 kN·m residual imbalance from weighing, the total is 5,025 kN·m, so a leg touching at 4.0 m radius carries about 1,256 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 轉動前確認氣象預報與現場風速計運作，訂定轉動上限風速；轉動中由監測中心整合全站儀、間隙感測器、千斤頂壓力與應變資料即時顯示，任一項達警戒值即減速，達停止值即停機鎖定，所有資料以同一時間基準保存。~Before rotation confirm the forecast and that site anemometers work, and set a maximum wind speed; during rotation a monitoring centre combines total-station, gap-sensor, jack-pressure and strain data in real time, slowing at any alert value and stopping and locking at any stop value, with all data stored on a common time base.
units.failure: 監測資料分散在不同單位、不同時間基準，轉動中無法即時判斷撐腳是否接觸；陣風突然加大時繼續轉動，結構傾斜、撐腳衝擊滑道，造成滑道損壞或懸臂端劇烈晃動。~Monitoring scattered across teams on different time bases cannot tell in real time whether a leg is touching; continuing to turn as gusts rise lets the structure tilt and legs strike the slideway, damaging it or making the tips sway violently.
units.misconception: 轉動只需要量轉角，到位後再量高程即可。~Only the rotation angle needs measuring during the turn; levels can be checked on arrival.
units.practice: 轉動作業前召開停留點會議，確認監測項目、警戒與停止值、通訊方式、風速限制與緊急鎖定程序；總指揮、設計代表、監造與鐵路或航道主管機關代表均需在場。~Hold a hold-point meeting before rotation to confirm monitored items, alert and stop values, communications, wind limit and emergency locking; the rotation director, design representative, supervising engineer and the railway or waterway authority representative must all be present.

units.anchor: 封固後承台沉陷~Pile-cap settlement after fixing
units.title: 封固後的體系轉換與長期沉陷~System change after fixing and long-term settlement
units.mechanism: 轉體期間全部重量集中在球鉸，再由下轉盤擴散到承台與樁基；封鉸後球鉸、撐腳與封固混凝土共同成為墩底，結構體系由單點支承轉為固結。接著與相鄰跨合龍，懸臂成為連續梁的一部分，潛變使內力逐漸重分配。因為整座 T 構只坐在一個承台上，承台的不均勻沉陷會直接轉為懸臂端的高程變化；跨越鐵路時，這個變化還關係到下方淨空與相鄰跨的接縫。~During rotation all the weight passes through the hinge and spreads through the lower turntable into the pile cap and piles; after encasement the hinge, legs and encasement concrete together form the pier base and the system changes from a single-point support to a fixed base. Closure with adjacent spans then makes the cantilevers part of a continuous girder, and creep gradually redistributes forces. Because the whole T-frame stands on one pile cap, differential settlement of that cap translates directly into tip-level changes, which over a railway also affect the clearance below and the joints with adjacent spans.
units.model: 承台寬 10 m，兩側樁群差異沉陷 Δs = 5 mm：承台傾角 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad，傳到 60 m 懸臂端的高程變化約 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm，足以影響閉合段高程與相鄰伸縮縫。數值為教學假設。~For a 10 m wide pile cap with Δs = 5 mm differential settlement between pile groups, the cap tilts 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad, changing the 60 m tip level by about 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm, enough to affect the closure level and the adjacent expansion joint. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在承台四角與兩懸臂端設永久沉陷與高程觀測點，於轉動前、轉動後、封鉸後、合龍後及通車後定期量測，與預測沉陷曲線比較；封鉸混凝土定期檢查裂縫，並確認排水孔暢通，避免積水進入球鉸區。~Set permanent settlement and level points at the four cap corners and both tips, survey them before and after rotation, after encasement, after closure and periodically after opening, and compare with the predicted settlement curve; inspect the encasement concrete for cracks and keep drains clear so water does not reach the hinge zone.
units.failure: 若只在轉動前後量測，忽略封鉸與合龍後的長期沉陷，數年後懸臂端下沉、伸縮縫錯台，跨鐵路段淨空逐漸減少；封鉸混凝土與既有轉盤之間若形成冷縫且未處理，雨水滲入使球鉸鋼板與錨筋腐蝕。~Surveying only around the rotation and ignoring long-term settlement after encasement and closure lets the tips drop and joints step over the years while clearance over the railway shrinks; an untreated cold joint between encasement and turntable lets rainwater reach the hinge plates and anchors, corroding them.
units.misconception: 封鉸後球鉸就失去作用，之後的沉陷與耐久與轉體無關。~Once encased, the hinge plays no further role, so later settlement and durability have nothing to do with the rotation.
units.practice: 承台與樁基設計須以轉體期間的單點集中荷載與封固後的長期荷載兩種狀態檢核，並在交接文件中保留沉陷觀測歷程與預測曲線；任何鄰近開挖或降水工程須通知橋梁管理單位評估。~Pile cap and pile design must be checked for both the single-point load during rotation and the long-term load after fixing, with the settlement history and predicted curve kept in the handover file; any nearby excavation or dewatering must be notified to the bridge owner for assessment.

units.anchor: 跨鐵路淨空預算~Clearance budget over the railway
units.title: 跨越營運線的淨空預算與交接~Clearance budget over a live line and handover
units.mechanism: 轉體橋多半跨越營運中的鐵路或道路，完工後下方仍有列車與電車線，所以梁底淨空不能只在完工當天符合，而要在整個使用年限內符合：潛變下垂、承台沉陷、未來鋪面加鋪與鐵路軌道抬升都會吃掉淨空。交接時必須把這些因素做成淨空預算，並說明實測基準；同時把轉體期間的全部紀錄（稱重、試轉、轉動監測、封鉸）整理為工程檔案，因為日後的任何評估都需要知道這座橋曾經承受過的特殊臨時狀態。~Rotated bridges usually cross live railways or roads, so trains and catenary remain below after completion, and soffit clearance must hold not just on opening day but throughout the service life: creep sag, pile-cap settlement, future resurfacing and track lifting all consume clearance. Handover must therefore present a clearance budget with measured baselines, and compile every rotation record, from weighing, trial turn and rotation monitoring to encasement, into the engineering file, because any later assessment needs to know the unusual temporary states the bridge has experienced.
units.model: 懸臂端彈性撓度 25 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時潛變下垂 25×2.0 = 50 mm；完工實測淨空 7.25 m，扣除 0.05 m 後為 7.20 m，若鐵路要求最小 7.00 m，尚餘 0.20 m 供沉陷與軌道抬升使用。數值為教學假設。~With a 25 mm elastic tip deflection and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, creep sag is 25×2.0 = 50 mm; an as-built clearance of 7.25 m becomes 7.20 m, and against a railway minimum of 7.00 m, 0.20 m remains for settlement and future track lifting. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 通車前與鐵路主管機關共同量測梁底至軌面的淨空並簽認，作為基準；之後在定期檢查中以相同測點與方法重測，扣除溫度影響後比較趨勢，接近預算下限時提早規劃處置。~Before opening, measure soffit-to-rail clearance jointly with the railway authority and sign it as the baseline; at routine inspections re-measure at the same points by the same method, correct for temperature, compare the trend and plan remedies early if the budget's lower limit approaches.
units.failure: 交接時沒有淨空預算與基準，多年後鐵路抬升軌道或加裝設備時才發現淨空不足，只能限制列車或緊急改善；轉體紀錄遺失則讓日後評估者無法判斷某些裂縫是否源自轉動期間的臨時受力。~Without a clearance budget and baseline at handover, insufficient clearance is discovered only years later when the railway lifts its track or adds equipment, forcing restrictions or urgent works; lost rotation records leave later assessors unable to tell whether certain cracks date from temporary forces during rotation.
units.misconception: 跨鐵路的梁底淨空只要在完工驗收時合格即可。~Soffit clearance over a railway only has to pass at completion.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含轉體全過程紀錄、球鉸與封鉸細部竣工圖、淨空預算與基準、沉陷觀測計畫，以及與鐵路或道路主管機關的介面聯絡窗口；檢查時進入鐵路範圍須依其安全規定申請封鎖時段。~Handover documents should contain the full rotation record, as-built hinge and encasement details, the clearance budget and baseline, the settlement monitoring plan and interface contacts with the railway or road authority; inspections inside the railway corridor must apply for possessions under its safety rules.

example: 設計比較練習：轉體重 W = 150,000 kN，牽引半徑 4.5 m 由兩台千斤頂形成力偶，啟動靜摩擦 μ_s = 0.08、運行動摩擦 μ_d = 0.04，比較球鉸半徑 R = 2.0 m 與 2.5 m。R = 2.0 m：接觸應力 150,000/(π×2.0²) ≈ 11.9 MPa；啟動力矩 (2/3)×0.08×150,000×2.0 = 16,000 kN·m，每台千斤頂 16,000/(2×4.5) ≈ 1,778 kN；運行力矩 8,000 kN·m，每台約 889 kN。R = 2.5 m：接觸應力降為 150,000/(π×2.5²) ≈ 7.6 MPa（降低約 36%），但啟動力矩升為 20,000 kN·m，每台約 2,222 kN；運行力矩 10,000 kN·m，每台約 1,111 kN（增加 25%）。若 60 m 懸臂端轉動 70°（弧長約 73.3 m）且端點速度限 1.2 m/min，純轉動約 73.3/1.2 ≈ 61 min。結論：加大球鉸換來較低的接觸應力與較大的承壓餘裕，代價是牽引力與千斤頂規格提高，兩者需與封鎖時段及設備可用性一起權衡。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Design comparison: rotating weight W = 150,000 kN, a 4.5 m traction radius with two jacks in a couple, static breakaway μ_s = 0.08 and running μ_d = 0.04, comparing hinge radii R = 2.0 m and 2.5 m. For R = 2.0 m the contact stress is 150,000/(π×2.0²) ≈ 11.9 MPa; the breakaway torque is (2/3)×0.08×150,000×2.0 = 16,000 kN·m, so each jack needs 16,000/(2×4.5) ≈ 1,778 kN; the running torque is 8,000 kN·m, about 889 kN per jack. For R = 2.5 m the contact stress falls to 150,000/(π×2.5²) ≈ 7.6 MPa, about 36% lower, but the breakaway torque rises to 20,000 kN·m, about 2,222 kN per jack, and the running torque to 10,000 kN·m, about 1,111 kN per jack, 25% more. Turning a 60 m tip through 70°, an arc of about 73.3 m, at a 1.2 m/min tip limit takes about 73.3/1.2 ≈ 61 min. Conclusion: a larger hinge buys lower contact stress and more bearing margin at the cost of higher traction and larger jacks, to be weighed together with the possession window and equipment availability. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 轉體施工的構想很早就用於活動橋，但作為「先在旁邊建、再轉到位」的施工法，是在 1980 年代隨著大型球面支承與同步液壓設備成熟而普及。比利時默茲河上的 Ben-Ahin 斜張橋主跨 168 m，1985 至 1987 年施工時以繞豎軸旋轉的方式就位；1989 年 5 月塞維亞 Barqueta 鋼拱橋則在岸邊組裝後，以浮力支撐一端旋轉到 Alfonso XII 運河上方。此後中國大量以水平轉體跨越營運中的鐵路，單次轉體重量達數萬噸；美國 FHWA 2011 年的加速橋梁施工手冊也把豎軸旋轉列為重型移動工法之一。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~The idea of rotation has long been used in movable bridges, but as a construction method of building alongside and then swinging into place it spread in the 1980s as large spherical bearings and synchronised hydraulics matured. The Ben-Ahin cable-stayed bridge over the Meuse in Belgium, with a 168 m main span, was rotated about a vertical axis into position during its 1985–1987 construction; in May 1989 Seville's Barqueta steel arch, assembled on the bank, was swung over the Alfonso XII channel with one end supported by flotation. China has since used horizontal rotation extensively to cross live railways, with single rotations reaching tens of thousands of tonnes, and FHWA's 2011 Accelerated Bridge Construction manual lists the vertical-axis pivot among heavy-movement methods. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
